votes.motion: to approve the minutes from the October 15, 2020 Planning
votes.result: A voice vote was made, motion passed 7-0

votes.motion: to approve a Conditional Use Permit to allow the operation of a commercial embroidery and screen printing business on the property located at 312 West Vine Street, subject to the following conditions: 1. The applicant shall comply with all applicable Building and Fire Codes. 2. The dumpsters shall be relocated inside the building or shall be placed inside a trash enclosure meeting the requirements of Section 17.76.170 of the Murray City Land Use Ordinance

to approve a Conditional Use Permit to allow the construction and/or operation of an Accessory Dwelling Unit at the property addressed 5112 South Honey Clover Court, subject to the following conditions: 1. The project shall comply with all applicable building and fire code standards. 2. Interconnected smoke detectors and CO sensors shall be provided throughout the house. 3. The property owner shall obtain a building permit for any proposed remodeling or construction on the site

votes.result: A voice vote was made, motion passed 7-0
